primary_object: sensitivity boundary for the frozen data-only surrogate/certificate decision rule on the tested action grid

semantic_repair.direct_branch: absorbing-direct conservative surrogate coupled to the corresponding registered-event toggle model
semantic_repair.coupling_inequality: F_toggle <= F_surrogate for identical registered events, initial state and restoration actions under the fixed partition
semantic_repair.scope: declared registered-event population/model only; no statement about unobserved physical events
semantic_repair.none_action: no action in the tested U passes the selected model/rule; not physical infeasibility of all restoration periods
semantic_repair.tau_grid_minimum: 1 s is an exploratory tested-action minimum, not an architectural minimum
semantic_repair.phase_scope: 16-phase implementation; convergence checks are numerical sensitivity checks, not rigorous uniform error bounds
semantic_repair.energy_scope: measured-support labels refer to measured input support; interpolated/extrapolated model values are not measured calibration

theta.name: DIRECT-REALIZATION SENSITIVITY PARAMETER
theta.meaning: fraction of declared DCLUSTER candidate K>=2 registered-event population reassigned from the residual stream to the absorbing-direct surrogate branch

frozen.initial_state: clean per reporting window; no carry

root_solver.method: bracketing/bisection with exact frozen tau=1 model evaluation

action_transitions.method: monotone piecewise cumulative-hazard interpolation between frozen exact theta anchors; representative transitions exact-validated
action_transitions.NONE_interpretation: no tested action passes the selected surrogate/certificate rule

energy_classification.metric: continuous change in theta_M,crit across theta_L=0->1 plus structural axis-crossing
energy_classification.qualification: classification is conditional on the implemented energy model/support and does not turn interpolation/extrapolation into measurement
